name: Trakt Core
description: Shared Trakt default username and Client ID for the trakt_* widgets. Public profiles work with a Client ID only — no OAuth. Episode air times come from Trakt's calendar.

settings.name: client_id
settings.label: Trakt Client ID
settings.help: Required. Create an app at trakt.tv/oauth/applications (redirect urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob is fine). Only the Client ID is needed for public profiles.

settings.name: username
settings.label: Default Trakt username
settings.help: Used when a widget cell leaves username blank. A profile URL also works. The profile must be public.
